title: Recycler Trip Pricing for Old Appliances on Northgate Delivery & Installation
content:
How far ahead a removal can be planned with the recycler decides how the removed appliances beyond the included items are priced on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment. The span is counted in calendar days from the appointment's booking date to its currently booked delivery date:

| Calendar days from the booking date to the currently booked delivery date | How the removed appliances beyond the included items are priced |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | One consolidated recycler trip: the per-item removal fee charged once, whatever the number of appliances |
| 10 to 20 | The first appliance at the per-item removal fee and every further appliance at half of it (0.5 of the fee) |
| Fewer than 10 | Every appliance at the per-item removal fee |

The removal amount is the removed appliances beyond the included items as this schedule prices them. Where no appliance is beyond the included items, there is nothing to price.

## Worked cases (hypothetical per-item removal fee of $20.00)

| Days in the span | Appliances beyond the included items | Removal amount |
|---|---|---|
| 25 | 3 | $20.00 (one trip) |
| 21 | 1 | $20.00 |
| 20 | 3 | $20.00 plus $10.00 plus $10.00, $40.00 |
| 10 | 2 | $20.00 plus $10.00, $30.00 |
| 9 | 3 | $60.00 |
| 25 | 0 | Nothing |
